source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
A unit is 1 or more models that move and fight together, and a model’s base is part of the model. Your units and models are friendly, your opponent’s are enemy, and a rule naming neither affects both. An effect on a unit applies to all its models.

Strength:

- **Starting strength** is a unit’s model count as battle round 1 starts, counting attached models; a unit added mid-battle counts when added.
- At starting strength 2 or more, compare the models left with it: fewer is **below starting strength**, exactly half is **half-strength**, fewer than half is **below half-strength**.
- At starting strength 1, compare the model’s remaining wounds with its W the same way.

How long effects last:

- A persisting effect on a unit placed in **strategic reserves** or embarked in a **TRANSPORT** is noted and runs its full duration once the unit is back on the battlefield.
- A rule with no stated duration that names when it triggers, such as ‘In the Shooting phase’, lasts only for that period.
- Any other rule or effect given to a unit with no stated duration lasts only for the phase it was given in.

Models a rule adds to a unit, or revives, resurrects or returns to it:

- never take it past its starting strength
- come from its **destroyed** models, unless they are added
- unless stated otherwise, have full W and the wargear and enhancements they began the battle with
- on the battlefield, go in **coherency** with unit models that began the phase there, **engaged** only with enemy units already engaged with that unit
- for a unit inside a **TRANSPORT**, embark with it if there is room, and are otherwise destroyed without triggering rules for a model being destroyed

A revived leader or support model rejoins its **attached unit** if possible.

A unit embarked in a **TRANSPORT** or in strategic reserves is off the battlefield:

- It can’t see or be seen by other units, and no distances are measured to or from it except for its own abilities, so nothing needing visibility or range can pick it.
- It still uses its other rules and is still affected by rules that pick a unit from its army or affect a whole army.
- Its controller takes **battle-shock rolls** for it in each of their Command phases while it is **battle-shocked** or at half-strength or below.

Splitting units:

- Models already split can’t be split again.
- Split into 2 units as equal in size as possible, noting which models form each.
- A split before the battle sets each new unit’s starting strength to its own model count.
- If a stated split size can’t be met, such as with attached Leader or Support models, use the even split.

Other definitions:

- An ‘other’ model or unit is any but the one with the rule or one it already named, even a copy of the same datasheet.
- A descriptor such as **TERMINATOR**, hidden or battle-shocked fits a unit if at least 1 of its models fits it, but gives a rule to every model only if the rule says it gives it to the unit.
- ‘A’ unit, model or object means 1 or more.
- Tokens are never models; move one aside if a model needs its space.
- ‘All types of model’ covers friendly and enemy models with any keywords, such as **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**.
- To replace a model, mark the point under its base centre (central axis for **FRAME**) and put the new model’s base centre or axis over it; if that would put it on another model or over the battlefield edge, place it as near that point as possible.
